context.summary: On a cool November afternoon at Diniwid Beach, Neil stood on the roof deck facing the sea, capturing an aerial view of a serene resort site nestled among palm trees. Despite the neighboring resort's pool not being visually appealing, he focused on the property's great potential and its fantastic location in a semi-secluded cove. He could almost feel the gentle breeze as he admired this peaceful oasis from above, finally capturing a drone shot of The Windfall, the luxury bed and breakfast they are currently building, while doing an ocular inspection alone, considering the potential to restart renovations. The afternoon breeze enhanced the tranquility, yet he felt a bit anxious, wondering if the business plan would work.
